info.description: Application API endpoints protected by Better Auth session cookies. Health is liveness only.
info.title: AI Interview Practice API

get.description: Does not check database or LLM readiness.

post.summary: Analyze a raw JD without saving

put.summary: Update reviewed fields; original raw text is immutable

get.description: Recruiter only. Candidates never receive the bank.
get.summary: List the core-question bank of your own job posting

post.description: Recruiter only, while the posting is pending. Trusted Origin required. Unknown fields reject the whole request.
post.summary: Add a question to the bank of your own job posting

post.description: Recruiter only. Runs only while the bank is empty: a posting that already has questions returns 409 (a bank emptied by deleting every question can be generated again). Only while the posting is pending. Requires confirmed requirements. Trusted Origin required.
post.summary: Generate the core-question bank of your own job posting

delete.description: Recruiter only, while the posting is pending. A question already used by an interview cannot be deleted. Trusted Origin required.
delete.summary: Delete a question from the bank of your own job posting

patch.description: Recruiter only, while the posting is pending. Trusted Origin required. Unknown fields reject the whole request.
patch.summary: Edit a question in the bank of your own job posting

patch.description: Omitted keys are unchanged. Null removes image/company values; full_name cannot be null. Only recruiters may change company fields. Trusted Origin required. Unknown fields reject the whole request.
patch.summary: Update allowed fields in your own profile

parameters.description: Changed profile fields (at least one); body limit 16 KiB
parameters.name: request

requirement.description: Empty means the JD does not state whether the skill is required or preferred.

SessionCookie.description: Better Auth HttpOnly session cookie. Production uses __Secure-rolecue.session_token; browser sends cookies automatically.
SessionCookie.name: Cookie
